sections.heading: 1. Clam (side-lying hip exercise)
lines: ① Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together.
② Keep feet touching, lift the top knee gently.
③ Don't let your hips roll back.
④ 10 each side, once a day.

caption:
Koko walks in the park for an hour every morning, but on longer walks her hips and lower back start to feel heavy.

Every step, you briefly balance on one leg. When the side hip muscles and trunk help hold the pelvis steady, walking can feel easier. Clinical Pilates can help build that support gradually, so you keep doing what you love.

Hybi's 1-minute prep: side-lying clams, 10 each side, once a day. Stop if pain gets worse.

Pain that keeps building or wakes you at night is worth an assessment. Chat to our team at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio 🐨
